delegated_order.encode_type: TaskOrder(string chainId,string user,bytes32 sessionId,uint64 orderSequence,bytes32 modelId,uint32 profileVersion,string maxFee,string feeDenom,uint64 earliestSubmitHeight,uint64 orderExpireHeight,bytes32 taskHash)
delegated_order.fee_denom_source: feeDenom is not a TaskOrderV3 field and does not enter taskHash. It must equal the chain business_denom, hub.v1 Params phase0.business_denom; the chain stores and compares amounts only, and the Keeper verifies the signature with feeDenom set to its current business_denom. "uusdc" here is that parameter's default.
delegated_order.note: Order domain version 3 binds a raw bytes32 model ID; earlier order domains have no fresh-genesis decoder.

notes: Only session-key authorization is varied; all other admission conditions, canonical anchor membership and owner public-key availability are assumed valid unless a row explicitly overrides them.
Amounts are decimal strings; context heights are exact JSON integers. Keys are public deterministic test material. Same-height rows are ordered transactions in one block.
Requests have sessionGrantHash zero and do not consume spend_cap. The existing off-chain SessionGrant format is unchanged.

Only ERR_SESSION_KEY_INVALID, ERR_SESSION_KEY_EXPIRED and ERR_SESSION_KEY_SPEND_CAP_EXCEEDED name new public errors; the other expected strings are conformance outcome labels, not additional ABCI codes.
